tasks.title: Align corporate form, name and corporate object
tasks.why: The Brazilian entity must have an authorized legal form and its constitutional documents must reflect the regulated SPSAV business.
actions: Compare current articles with Res. 520 requirements.
Draft required amendments to corporate name and principal corporate object.
Check Junta Comercial filing requirements and timing.
Ensure constitutional wording matches the modality selected in P1-01.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Corporate records match the selected SPSAV modality and required Brazilian legal form/denomination.

tasks.title: Appoint and allocate at least three responsible directors/administrators
tasks.involved: Brazilian Legal; Compliance; HR; Risk; Security
tasks.why: Res. 520 requires at least three directors or administrators responsible to BCB across specified regulatory domains.
actions: Identify at least three eligible directors/administrators.
Allocate responsibility for business conduct, AML/CFT/CPF, compliance/internal controls, risk/capital/disclosures and cybersecurity.
Check incompatibilities and conflicts where one person covers multiple functions.
Prepare appointment records, role descriptions and BCB-facing responsibility matrix.
tasks.definitionOfDone: At least three appointed administrators collectively cover every required regulatory responsibility with no unresolved incompatibility.
tasks.risk: Management structure is a potential authorization blocker, not a future HR tidy-up.

tasks.title: Confirm Brazilian physical establishment and record-access arrangements
tasks.regulatoryBasis: Res. 520 operating/governance requirements; IN 704 business-plan information
tasks.why: BCB expects an identifiable Brazilian operating structure and access to regulatory records.
actions: Document the approved physical office and responsible local personnel.
Confirm regulatory records can be accessed from Brazil when requested.
Update corporate, tax and BCB records with consistent address information.
Document channels through which customers and BCB can contact the entity.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Registered location and operational/access arrangements are documented and consistent across corporate and regulatory records.

tasks.title: Calculate activity-based minimum capital and net-worth requirement
tasks.why: Final minimum capital is activity-based. Legacy proposed fixed SPSAV figures should not be used as the answer.
actions: Map Kinetic's regulated activities to the current minimum-capital methodology.
Calculate each base/additional component applicable to the entity.
Document assumptions on outsourced/foreign services and activities.
Have Brazilian counsel or prudential adviser review the calculation.
tasks.definitionOfDone: A signed calculation shows the minimum paid-in capital and net worth Kinetic must maintain under the current methodology.
tasks.risk: Capital methodology changed from earlier consultation-era expectations.

tasks.title: Fund any capital shortfall and evidence source of funds
tasks.regulatoryBasis: Capital requirements plus authorization source-of-funds/economic-capacity requirements
tasks.why: A paper capital plan is not capital. Any shortfall must be funded, booked and provable.
actions: Compare current paid-in capital/net worth with CG-04 requirement plus management buffer.
Approve capital injection if required.
Perform source-of-funds and controller economic-capacity checks.
Complete banking, corporate and accounting steps for contribution.
Update capital records and filing documents.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Kinetic meets the calculated minimum with documented funding provenance and updated corporate/accounting records.
